UpdateStageName: Steam Workshop, then team CDN fallback
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "umask 077; if [ -n '{{SteamUsername}}' ]; then mkdir -p '{{$FullRootDir}}' 2>/dev/null; printf '%s\n' '{{SteamUsername}}' '{{SteamPassword}}' '{{SteamGuardCode}}' > '{{$FullRootDir}}fb-creds.txt' 2>/dev/null; fi; SRC='{{ServerSource}}' TAG='{{ReleaseTag}}' ITEM='{{WorkshopItemID}}' ROOT='{{$FullRootDir}}' BASE='{{$FullBaseDir}}' GAMEPORT='{{$GamePort}}' GAMEPORT2='{{$GamePort2}}' GAME_VERSION='{{GameVersion}}' COOP_BUILD='{{CoopBuild}}' COOP_COMMIT='{{CoopCommit}}' STRICT_VERSION='{{BlockOnVersionMismatch}}' bash -c 'echo  | base64 -d | bash'"
